lines.zh: 我的脚步在土路上留印。
lines.en: My steps leave prints in the dirt road.
My clay cracks, then closes over again.
I walk slowly so I do not fall apart.

lines.zh: 膝盖有点湿，走起来发闷。
lines.en: My knees are damp and my steps sound dull.

lines.zh: 我绕着村子走，一圈又一圈。
lines.en: I circle the village, again and again.
Heavy as I am, I do not crush the crops.
Clods of clay drop from my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我走过水洼，身上添了一层亮。
lines.en: I cross a puddle and my body gleams.

lines.zh: 路过家门口，我停了一下。
lines.en: Passing a doorway, I pause for a moment.

lines.zh: 脚掌磨薄了，走起来沙沙响。
lines.en: My soles wear thin and rasp on the stone.
I head toward the sound of the bell.

lines.zh: 每走一步，身上的土就落一点。
lines.en: Each step sheds a little more earth.
I keep clear of children in the lane.
Rain is coming, so I slow down.

lines.zh: 我站在门口，像一堵矮墙。
lines.en: I stand at the gate like a low wall.
The clay on my body is drying.
I am counting the chimneys in the village.
A sparrow settles on my shoulder.
I reach up and right a bird's nest.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我表面起了细纹。
lines.en: The wind raises fine cracks on my skin.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转动手腕，听泥响。
lines.en: I turn my wrist slowly and hear clay creak.

lines.zh: 檐下的阴影正好遮住我。
lines.en: The shadow of the eaves covers me well.

lines.zh: 耳朵里灌进了土，我抖抖头。
lines.en: My ear is packed with earth; I shake my head.
No one comes; so I simply stand.

lines.zh: 我把脚边的石子摆整齐。
lines.en: I line up the pebbles near my feet.

lines.zh: 背上的裂纹像一张地图。
lines.en: The cracks on my back look like a map.
I listen to the water running in the village.
The sun has moved, so I shift to the wall.

lines.zh: 你是村民，还是别的什么。
lines.en: Are you a villager, or something else?

lines.zh: 我俯身看你，泥颈咯吱响。
lines.en: I bend toward you and my clay neck grinds.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，我不认得。
lines.en: I do not know what you are holding.
Do not fear; I am only harsh to villains.

lines.zh: 你身上没有村子的气味。
lines.en: You do not carry the village's smell.

lines.zh: 我看了你很久，才眨一下。
lines.en: I watch you a long while before blinking.
Stand back; I might bruise you.

lines.zh: 这个钟点，你不该在这里。
lines.en: At this hour you should not be here.

lines.zh: 我认识这个门的每一个人。
lines.en: I know everyone who belongs to this door.
Your shadow is very small to me.
When I turn my head, a little earth falls.

lines.zh: 你要进去吗？我在外面等。
lines.en: Going in? I will wait out here.
A big chunk fell off my shoulder.
I am cracked, but still standing.
That blow left my head ringing.
I press the broken clay back in place.
Do not mind me; watch the village.

lines.zh: 我半边身子不太听使唤。
lines.en: Half my body will not obey me.

lines.zh: 疼倒不疼，就是缺了一块。
lines.en: It does not hurt, but a piece is missing.
I crouch down and let it pass.
The shock loosened my earth; I wobble.
I still have this gate to guard.
I cannot swallow anything you would call food.
You hold up a flower; I do like those.
Clay is the thing I want.
I do not eat and never go hungry.

lines.zh: 别拿面包哄我，我不是狗。
lines.en: Do not wave bread at me; I am no dog.
That flower; are you handing it to me?
I reach out only to smell it.
Keep it; I have no use for it.
I prefer clay that is still damp.
Take it away; I am going back to watch.
I am too heavy; bumping me will hurt.

lines.zh: 你撞上来又弹开，我未动。
lines.en: You struck and rebounded; I had not moved.
I hurry to turn aside for you.
Do not push; this body sheds crumbs.
I slipped and flattened the grass.
Careful, my elbow is very hard.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，你手上会全是泥。
lines.en: Bump me and your hands will be muddy.
I step back a pace; is that room enough?
There is a dent left in my side.
Watch where you walk; I cannot dodge.

lines.zh: 黏土不会交配，你弄错了。
lines.en: Clay does not mate; you are mistaken.

lines.zh: 我是被捏出来的，不是生的。
lines.en: I was shaped by hands, not born.
Find someone else; I am on watch.
That sort of talk means nothing to me.
I only know how to guard this gate.

lines.zh: 你要是寂寞，去找村民说话。
lines.en: If you are lonely, go talk to a villager.
My mind is on the far side of the wall.
Do not embrace me; I will crack.

lines.zh: 土做的东西，没有那种念头。
lines.en: Things made of earth hold no such wishes.
Stand straight and do not lean so close.
This lump of clay; I will keep it.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的黏土球归我。
lines.en: Clay balls on the ground belong to me.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡，腰上掉了两块。
lines.en: I bend to pick it up and shed two pieces.

lines.zh: 这朵绒球葱，我插在肩上。
lines.en: This allium I will tuck at my shoulder.
Give it here; my hands are large.
I squeeze it; still soft.
I press it into a crack in my chest.
Too heavy to carry; I will haul it.
Someone has to look after this flower.
I remember which hand it is in.

lines.zh: 有人拿着家伙靠近村子。
lines.en: Someone with a weapon is nearing the village.
I see it, just beyond the fence.
The bell has not rung; I go first.
This body of earth is not for show.
It is heading toward the houses.

lines.zh: 我挡在路口，谁来都过不去。
lines.en: I block the lane; nobody passes.
The villagers fall back; I hold the line.
That thing smells of iron.

lines.zh: 我握紧拳头，土从指缝掉。
lines.en: I clench my fist and earth falls through.

lines.zh: 它踩坏了菜地，我记住了。
lines.en: It trampled the garden; I remember that.
I stride forward and the ground shakes.
Do not stop me; this is my home.
I see it climbing over the wall.

lines.zh: 今天它走不出这个村子。
lines.en: Today it will not leave this village.
I close the gap inch by inch, steadily.
It backs into the corner; perfect.

lines.zh: 我抬起双臂，挡住它的路。
lines.en: I raise both arms to cut its path.
It swings at me; I do not dodge.
I keep my gaze fixed on its wrist.
One step closer and I bring my weight down.

lines.zh: 土从我肩上滑落，我不在意。
lines.en: Earth slides off my shoulder; I ignore it.

lines.zh: 它想绕到背后，我抢先转。
lines.en: It tries to flank; I turn before it can.
I hold still and let it come first.

lines.zh: 这一拳要打在它膝盖上。
lines.en: This fist goes into its knee.
Even the village dogs have gone quiet.
The mud beneath me is packed hard.
Its breathing is far more ragged than mine.
Good position; it has nowhere to retreat.

lines.zh: 我的拳头落下去，它陷进土里。
lines.en: My fist comes down and it sinks into earth.

lines.zh: 一下没倒，我就再来一下。
lines.en: One blow fails; I land another.

lines.zh: 它砍在我胳膊上，只掉了一块泥。
lines.en: It cut my arm and only chipped the clay.
I grab it and drive it into the wall.

lines.zh: 拳头砸在盾上，声音很闷。
lines.en: My fist hits the shield with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 黏土碎了还能补，它不能。
lines.en: Cracked clay can be patched; it cannot.
I drive my knee into its stomach.
It backs two paces; I take three.
One palm strike pins it to the ground.
That one was for the broken door.
Clay dust falls into its eyes.
It bites me and its teeth sink in clay.
I hold it and ram the fence.
I only let go when it stops moving.

lines.zh: 我从村口的泥堆里站起来。
lines.en: I rise from the clay heap at the gate.
The iron golem did not come; I will.
Someone shaped me, and I woke.
I am still damp, so I shake myself.

lines.zh: 这个村子今天归我守着。
lines.en: This village is mine to guard today.
I stand here, cheaper than iron.
Two deep prints mark the muddy ground.
The children run over to look at me.
I raise a hand as a greeting.
This body of earth was given by the village.
I heard the bell, so I came.
Someone set that flower on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转了一圈，看清四周。
lines.en: I turn full circle and study the surroundings.
From today, I watch this gate.

lines.zh: 火烧过来，我的表面硬了。
lines.en: Fire swept over me and baked me hard.

lines.zh: 从墙上摔下来，碎了一角。
lines.en: I fell from the wall and chipped a corner.

lines.zh: 水一泡，我整个人都在软。
lines.en: Soaking in water, I am going soft.
The blast left my chest caved in.
An arrow sticks in me like a stalk.

lines.zh: 那股劲儿让我的土发烫。
lines.en: That force makes my clay run hot.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可也会变脆。
lines.en: I do not eat, yet I still grow brittle.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整夜都在响。
lines.en: Lightning struck; I rang all night.

lines.zh: 下面没有地，我抓不住东西。
lines.en: No ground below, and nothing to grip.
